numbering: Episodes numbered continuously 1–38 across both seasons (Season 2 is episodes 25–38).

arcs.name: First Selection
arcs.summary: After Japan's World Cup failure, the football union locks 300 young strikers in a facility called Blue Lock to forge the world's most selfish egoist striker. Yoichi Isagi is one of them.
events: Ego Jinpachi tells the players that losers are banned from Japan's national team forever.
Isagi's Team Z wins its way out of elimination in a round-robin of five-on-five teams.
Isagi learns to read the field and finish plays himself.

arcs.name: Second Selection
arcs.summary: Survivors must team up and steal each other's teammates in a series of three-on-three-plus matches.
events: Isagi joins forces with Bachira to fight through the selection.
Isagi, Nagi and Barou form an unlikely trio of egoists.
Isagi's team falls to Rin Itoshi's top-ranked team, and Rin takes Bachira.

arcs.name: Third Selection
arcs.summary: The top players of Blue Lock are told they will face Japan's U-20 national team.
events: The survivors play mixed matches to fight for spots on the Blue Lock eleven.
Ego announces the match against U-20 Japan, with Blue Lock's future on the line.

arcs.name: U-20 Tryouts
arcs.summary: Blue Lock's players fight for places in the lineup that will face U-20 Japan.
events: New talents like Karasu, Otoya and Yukimiya show what they can do.
Isagi learns to adapt with his 'flow' state.

arcs.name: Blue Lock vs. U-20 Japan
arcs.summary: Blue Lock faces the U-20 national team, led by Rin's older brother Sae Itoshi, before a national audience.
events: Sae Itoshi takes on his brother Rin on the pitch.
Substitutes like Bachira and Nagi change the game in the second half.
Isagi scores the winning goal in the final minute.

filler.note: No filler: every episode adapts the manga (the EPISODE Nagi film is a spin-off retelling and is left out).
